title: classified.seller_content
description: One seller's PUBLIC identity in the *.moderation_content shape, so stapel-moderation can carry a `seller` target type in a marketplace where stapel-profiles serves no moderation content of its own. Answers {seller_id, title (the display name), text, language, media, author_id, url, rating, seller_type}. `author_id` is the seller's own id, which is what makes 'you cannot report your own content' answerable without trusting anything a client sent. Never more than the public profile.

seller_id.description: The seller's user id — the moderation target_key.
